text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"Lifecycle emissions per unit of nuclear electricity are comparable to wind and lower than solar.","cited_pids":["nuclear#0"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"Nuclear output is firm and independent of weather, which could reduce the storage a decarbonised grid needs.","cited_pids":["nuclear#1"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"Nuclear power's land use per unit of energy is far lower than that of wind or solar.","cited_pids":["nuclear#3"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"Countries with large nuclear fleets decarbonised their grids faster than countries relying on renewables alone over the same period.","cited_pids":["nuclear#2"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"Nuclear plant construction takes a decade or more, so new plants may not cut emissions within near-term climate windows.","cited_pids":["nuclear#5"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"Recent nuclear projects have run late and over budget.","cited_pids":["nuclear#4"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"In some cases nuclear costs are uncompetitive with renewables.","cited_pids":["nuclear#4"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Cost overruns on nuclear projects have pushed some utilities into severe financial distress.","cited_pids":["nuclear#7"]},{"cid":"c9","text":"Long-term disposal of nuclear waste remains unresolved.","cited_pids":["nuclear#6"]},{"cid":"c10","text":"No country has yet commissioned a large permanent high-level nuclear waste repository.","cited_pids":["nuclear#6"]}]}
